main/melee/lb/lb_020A:fn_80020AEC.value: Reads the JObj's materialized matrix and its parent chain. evidence.why: Shows the complete flow from JObj and ancestor matrices through normalized column reconstruction to the caller-owned output matrix.
Shows the output matrix being transposed and used to transform the rotation-axis input.
